text:
anita: Noticed a regression on retrieval recall after onboarding mariner-40b-int8. embedding recall for the 'kb_faq' slice dropped ~9% on the 2k golden. putting notes here.

sam: Yikes. bench command + repro?

anita: Ran: ```python -m bench.embed_bench --model=mariner-40b-int8 --prompts=promptsets/kb_faq/2000.jsonl --index=faiss/kb_faq_v2 --metrics=recall@5 --out=logs/mariner-int8-embed.json```
Diffs & vectors uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/curation/embeds/mariner-int8/fails/ (includes failing queries + nearest-neighbor lists).

drew: Is this an embedding vector norm shift / post-quant centering issue or a tokenizer mismatch? int8 sometimes changes embed scale.

anita: Triage so far: 1) mean-norm shifted ~0.07 compared to fp16; 2) several queries with punctuation-normalization differences got lower sim scores; 3) a small cluster of near-duplicates were filtered by dedupe which hid some regressions.

hao: label-ops: can we run a recheck with dedupe=false and preserve-original-text? want fresh 1000-sample eval + manual review of 200 fails.

label_ops_bot: label-ops: created job #4082 4 - re-eval 1k embed recall for mariner-40b-int8 with dedupe=false + manual review set (200). assignee: drew. ETA: ~2h.

drew: I'll take #4082. anita please export the 1k samples and add expected retrieval targets (top-5 ground truth) in jsonl.

anita: Exported to /datasets/curation/mariner-int8/recheck-1000.jsonl and opened PR: https://github.com/redwood/curation/pull/689 (manifest + gold targets + notes about norm shift).

sam: I'll run a quick compare: fp16 vs int8 embedding distributions and recall on a 300-sample canary. cmd: ```python -m bench.embed_bench --model=mariner-40b-fp16 --compare-model=mariner-40b-int8 --prompts=promptsets/canary/300-kbfaq.jsonl --index=faiss/canary --metrics=recall@5 --out=logs/emb-fp16-vs-int8.json```

hao: Also suggest a micro-golden of 30 targeted retrieval anchors: punctuation variants, short queries, long context queries, and queries with NBSPs. path: promptsets/micro-gold/mariner-int8-emb-30.txt. drew can label the 30 quickly.

drew: will assemble and label. hope it helps decide whether to recalibrate centering or revert int8 rollout.

anita: If distribution shift is confirmed we can try per-batch centroid re-scaling or a tiny calibration pass (100k samples) to re-center vectors before FAISS. That would be cheaper than rolling back.

sam: Good plan. also run embedding cosine histograms and top-1 distance delta to confirm severity. I'll attach plots to PR.

label_ops_bot: job #4082 status: queued.

drew: Starting manual review once export finishes. ETA initial pass ~1h.

anita: tagging @sam @drew @hao for visibility :eyes:

label_ops_bot: job #4082 status: started.
